विंश (II) m. A twentieth part.
विंश (I) a. (f. शी) Twentieth.
विंशक a. (f. की) Twenty.
विंशक a. (f. की) Twenty.
विंशति f. A score, twenty.
विंशति-ईश, -ईशिन् m. ruler of twenty villages.
विंशति-ईश, -ईशिन् m. ruler of twenty villages.
विंशति-तम a. twentieth.
विंशिन् m. 1. Twenty; 2. a ruler of twenty villages.
विंख m. A horse’s hoof.
वींखा f. 1. Going, moving; 2. one of the paces of a horse; 3. dancing.
विंजामर n. The white of the eye.
विंजोलि f. A row, a line.
विनत a. (f. ता) 1. Bent down, bowed; 2. humble, modest; 3. curved, crooked; 4. sunk down, depressed, (pp. of नम् with वि q.v.).
विनत a. (f. ता) 1. Bent down, bowed; 2. humble, modest; 3. curved, crooked; 4. sunk down, depressed, (pp. of नम् with वि q.v.).
विनता f. 1. Name of the mother of Aruṇa and Garuḍa; 2. a kind of basket.
विनता-सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Garuḍa; 2. of Aruṇa.
विनता-सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Garuḍa; 2. of Aruṇa.
विनति f. 1. Bowing down; 2. humility, modesty.
विनद m. 1. Sound; 2. a kind of tree.
विनमन n. Bending, bowing.
विनम्र a. (f. म्रा) 1. Bent down; 2. depressed; 3. humble, modest.
विनम्र a. (f. म्रा) 1. Bent down; 2. depressed; 3. humble, modest.
विनम्रक n. The flower of the Tagara tree.
विनय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Secret; 2. cast, thrown.

विनय (II) m. 1. Moral training, discipline; 2. propriety of conduct, decorum, refinement, gentleman-like bearing, गुणैश्च तत्स्तैर्विनयप्रधानैः R.vi.79; 3. modesty, affability, mildness, वपुः प्रकर्षादजयद्गुरुं रघुस्तथापि नीचैर्विनयाददृश्यत R.iii.34; 3. reverence, obeisance; 4. subduing the senses, सम्यगराधिता विद्या प्रबोधविनयाविव R.x.71; 5. a man of subdued senses; 6. a trader, a merchant.
विनय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Secret; 2. cast, thrown.
विनय-ग्राहिन् a. obedient, tractable.
विनयन n. 1. Removing, taking aay, Megh.i.52; 2. instruction, education, discipline.
विनशन (I) n. Loss, destruction, disappearance.
विनशन (II) m. Name of that district in which the Sarasvatī is lost in the sand, हिमवद्विंध्योर्मध्यं यत्प्राग् विनशनादपि M.ii.21.
विनाशन n. Ruin, destruction.
विनष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Disappeared; 2. destroyed, ruined, perished; 3. corrupted.
विनष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Disappeared; 2. destroyed, ruined, perished; 3. corrupted.
विनस a. (f. सा or सी) Noseless, Bt.v.8.
विनस a. (f. सा or सी) Noseless, Bt.v.8.
विनाश m. 1. Ruin, destruction, decay, loss; 2. removal.
विनस a. (f. सा or सी) Noseless, Bt.v.8.

विना ind. Without, except, (with an acc., inst. or abl.), e.g. विना मलयमन्यत्र चंदनं न विवर्धते, or शशाम वृष्ट्यापि विना दवाग्निः R.ii.14, or विनाप्यस्मदलं भूष्णुरिज्यायै तपसः सुतः Sis.ii.9.(विनाकृ ‘to deprive of, to leave, to abondon,’ मदनेन विनाकृता रतिः K.S.iv.21.)
विन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Known; 2. obtained, gained; 3. discussed, investigated; 4. married; 5. placed, fixed.
विन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Known; 2. obtained, gained; 3. discussed, investigated; 4. married; 5. placed, fixed.
विना-उक्ति f. name of a figure of speech, thus defined by Mammata- विनोक्तिः सा विनान्येन यत्रान्यः सन्न नेतरः K.Pr.x.
विनाडि f. The sixtieth part of a ghaṭikā equal to twenty-four seconds.
विनाडि f. The sixtieth part of a ghaṭikā equal to twenty-four seconds.
विनायक m. 1. An epithet of Gaṇeśa; 2. a Buddhist deified teacher; 3. an epithet of Garuḍa; 4. obstacle, impediment.
विनाश-उन्मुख a. about to perish.
विनाश-धर्मन्, -धर्मिन् a. subject to decay, transient, e.g. विषयेषु विनाशधर्मसु … निःस्पृहोऽभवत्.
विनाश-धर्मन्, -धर्मिन् a. subject to decay, transient, e.g. विषयेषु विनाशधर्मसु … निःस्पृहोऽभवत्.
विनाह m. A cover for the mouth of a well.
वीनाह m. The cover of a well.
विनिग्रह m. 1. Restraining, subduing, आत्मविनिग्रहः Bg.xiii.7, xvii.16; 2. mutual opposition.
विनिद्र a. (f. द्रा) 1. Sleepless; 2. budded, blossomed, blown, विनिद्रमंदाररजोरुणांगुलिः K.S.v.80.
विनिद्र a. (f. द्रा) 1. Sleepless; 2. budded, blossomed, blown, विनिद्रमंदाररजोरुणांगुलिः K.S.v.80.

विनिपात m. 1. Falling down, a fall; 2. ruin, loss, evil, calamity, विवेकभ्रष्टानां भवति विनिपातः शतमुखः Bhartr.ii.10; where the word is used in this sense and in sense (1)]; 3. pain, distress; 4. disrespect.
विनिमय m. 1. Exchange, barter, संपद्विनिमयेनोसौ दधतुर्भुवनद्वयम् R.i.26; 2. a pledge, a deposit.
विनिमेष m. Twinkling of the eyes.
विनियत a. (f. ता) Checked, restrained, regulated.
विनियत a. (f. ता) Checked, restrained, regulated.
विनियम m. Check, control, restraint.
विनियुक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Separated, detached; 2. attached to, appointed; 3. enjoined, commanded.
विनियुक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Separated, detached; 2. attached to, appointed; 3. enjoined, commanded.

विनियोग m. 1. Separation, detachment; 2. leaving, abandoning; 3. use, application, बभूव विनियोगज्ञः साधनायेषु वस्तुषु R.xvii.67; 4. commission, task, विनियोगप्रसादा हि किंकराः प्रभविष्णुषु K.S.vi.62; 5. disposal; 6. impediment.
विनिर्णय m. 1. Complete settlement, full ascertainment; 2. a settled rule.
विनिर्बंध m. Persistence.
विनिर्मित a. (f. ता) Formed, made.
विनिर्मित a. (f. ता) Formed, made.
विनिवृत्ति f. Stopping, desisting, cessation, शक्राभ्यसूयाविनिवृत्तये यः R.vi.74.
विनिवेश m. 1. Entrance; 2. impression.
विनिश्चय m. 1. Ascertainment; 2. resolution, decision.
विनिश्वास m. Sighing, a sigh.
विनिष्पेष m. Grinding, bruising.
विनिहत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Struck, wounded; 2. killed.
विनिहत (II) n. 1. An unavoidable calamity; 2. a portent, a comet.
विनिहत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Struck, wounded; 2. killed.

विनीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Removed, taken away; 2. sent away, dismissed; 3. educated, disciplined, well-behaved; 4. modest, gentle; 5. gentleman-like, decent, decorous; 6. governable, tractable; 7. tamed; 8. self-subdued; 9. lovely, handsome, (pp. of नी with वि q.v.).
विनीत (II) m. 1. A trained horse; 2. a merchant.

विनीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Removed, taken away; 2. sent away, dismissed; 3. educated, disciplined, well-behaved; 4. modest, gentle; 5. gentleman-like, decent, decorous; 6. governable, tractable; 7. tamed; 8. self-subdued; 9. lovely, handsome, (pp. of नी with वि q.v.).
विनीतक m. A vehicle, a palanquin.
विनीय m. 1. Sediment; 2. sin.
विनेतृ m. 1. A chastiser, प्रत्यादिदेशाविनयं विनेता R.vi.39, xiv.23; 2. teacher, instructor; 3. a king, a ruler.

विनोद m. 1. Driving away, removing; 2. diversion, interesting occupation, प्रायेणैते रमणविरहेष्वंगनानां विनोदाः Megh.ii.24; 3. sport, pastime, play; 4. pleasure, gratification, जनयतु रसिकजनेषु मनोरमरतिरसभावविनोदम् Git.G.xii.; 5. eagerness.
विनोदन n. The same as विनोद q.v.
विन्दु (I) a. Wise, intelligent.
विन्दु (II) m. The same as बिंदु q.v.

विन्ध्य m. 1. Name of a range of mountains joining the northern extremities of the Western and Eastern Ghāts and separating Northern India from the Dekkan; it is one of the seven principal mountains and forms the southern bound ary of Āryāvarta, M.ii.21, R.xii.31; 2. a hunter.
विन्ध्य-अटवी f. the great Vindhya forest.
विन्ध्य-कूट, -कूटन m. an epithet of Agastya.
विन्ध्य-कूट, -कूटन m. an epithet of Agastya.
विन्ध्य-वासिनी f. an epithet of Durgā.
विन्नक m. An epithet of Agastya.
विन्यस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. deposited; 2. inlaid; 3. laid down, put down; 4. offered, presented.
विन्यस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. deposited; 2. inlaid; 3. laid down, put down; 4. offered, presented.
विन्यास m. 1. Depositing, entrusting; 2. a deposit; 3. collection, assemblage; 4. arrangement, composition, प्रत्यक्षरश्लेषमयप्रबन्धविन्यासवैदग्ध्यनिधिर्निबंधम् Vas.D.; 5. a receptacle.
विंब m.n. The same as बिंब q.v.
विंबी(बा) f. Name of a plant.
विंबक n. the same as बिंबक q.v.
विंबट m. The mustard plant.
विंबिका f. The same as बिंबिका q.v.
विंबित a. (f. ता) The same as बिंबित q.v.
विंबित a. (f. ता) The same as बिंबित q.v.
विंबी(बा) f. Name of a plant.
विंबु m. The betel-nut tree.
